text: Great combo.. Got everything I need. Use for my Goofy Robovac,

product_metadata.title: Replacement Parts Compatible with Eufy RoboVac 11S, RoboVac 30, RoboVac 30C, RoboVac 15C,RoboVac 12, RoboVac 35C Accessory Robotic Vacuum Cleaner Filters, Side Brushes,Rolling Brushes
features: 【Compatible Model】 : Compatible with Eufy RoboVac 11S, RoboVac 30, RoboVac 30C, RoboVac 15C,RoboVac 12, RoboVac 35C
【Replacement Kit】 : 1rolling brushes , 8 side brushes , 8 filters .Get a full kit rather than having to order separately.

【High Performance】 : Extend the life of your vacuum , work the same as the originals . Keep your RoboVac running at peak performance by changing the the consumable replenishment kit every 2~3 months,depending on your use frequency.
【Tips】: If the side brushes are bent or curled due to shipping, please recover them by simply soaking them in warm water for several minutes. It will not affect the quality and performance.
【Warranty and Guarantee】 : 3 months for return and refund with any reason . Lifetime aftersales support .
